finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs were hiding under the noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `retryCount`. That crashed the build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset flag as invalid instead of "off". The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw.

Both are fixed. The build finishes with exit code 0, "0 errors". The other 8 warnings left in the log are just deprecation noise, safe to ignore.
